rca of the issue: Previously, receive() per-line order was _land() → note validation → raise 400, so a damaged line with short note mutated the roll+inventory_movement before the 400 was raised. Fix (verified): all lines are now validated before any _land() call, so malformed damaged lines return 400 cleanly with no DB mutation. Confirmed by: (1) 400 status code, (2) all 10 rolls still in_transit_transfer after request, (3) transfer still 'dispatched', (4) no 'damaged' exception recorded on the transfer.
